name: molecule
definition: 由两个或多个原子通过化学键结合而成的电中性粒子，是化合物保持化学性质的最小单位。 Counterexample: 易与「原子」混淆：原子是元素的最小单位，不再由化学键拆分；分子由多个原子经化学键结合而成。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table molecule; provenance: direct source molecule

name: atom
definition: 构成分子的最小粒子单元，具有确定的元素种类，并通过化学键与其他原子相连。 Counterexample: 易与「分子」混淆：分子由多个原子经化学键结合而成，原子是其中的组成单元。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table atom; provenance: direct source atom

name: bond
definition: 分子内两个原子之间形成的连接，具有确定的键类型，是分子结构的组成部分。 Counterexample: 易与「连接记录」混淆：化学键是分子内原子间的化学连接本身，连接记录是记录某化学键所连接的两个原子的信息条目。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table bond; provenance: direct source bond

name: connected
definition: 记录某化学键所连接的两个原子的信息条目，用于表达原子间的连接关系。 Counterexample: 易与「化学键」混淆：化学键是分子内原子间的化学连接本身，连接记录是描述该连接涉及哪两个原子的信息条目。 Maturity: Provisional
scope: Records of table connected; provenance: direct source connected

name: Molecule
definition: A distinct chemical molecule identified by molecule_id.

name: Atom
definition: An individual atom belonging to a molecule, identified by atom_id.

name: Element
definition: The chemical element symbol of an atom.

name: CarbonAtom
definition: Atoms whose element is carbon.

name: Bond
definition: A chemical bond between two atoms, identified by bond_id.

name: BondType
definition: The type of a bond, such as single, double, or triple.

name: SingleBond
definition: Bonds of single type.

name: DoubleBond
definition: Bonds of double type.

name: TripleBond
definition: Bonds of triple type.

name: ConnectedAtom
definition: Atoms that participate in a bond, recorded in the connected table.

name: CarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecules labeled as carcinogenic.

name: NonCarcinogenicLabel
definition: Molecules labeled as non-carcinogenic.

name: CarbonPercentage
definition: Share of atoms that are carbon. Formula: CarbonAtom / Atom. Inputs: CarbonAtom = atom.element WHERE element = 'c'; Atom = atom.atom_id

name: DoubleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are double bonds. Formula: DoubleBond / Bond. Inputs: DoubleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '='; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: SingleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are single bonds. Formula: SingleBond / Bond. Inputs: SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: TripleBondPercentage
definition: Share of bonds that are triple bonds. Formula: TripleBond / Bond. Inputs: TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; Bond = bond.bond_id

name: CarcinogenicMoleculeCount
definition: Count of molecules labeled carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(CarcinogenicLabel). Inputs: CarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '+'

name: NonCarcinogenicMoleculeCount
definition: Count of molecules labeled non-carcinogenic. Formula: COUNT(NonCarcinogenicLabel). Inputs: NonCarcinogenicLabel = molecule.label WHERE label = '-'

name: AverageBondsPerMolecule
definition: Average number of bonds per molecule. Formula: Bond / Molecule. Inputs: Bond = bond.bond_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: AverageAtomsPerMolecule
definition: Average number of atoms per molecule. Formula: Atom / Molecule. Inputs: Atom = atom.atom_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: AtomsPerMolecule
definition: Number of atoms belonging to each molecule. Formula: COUNT(Atom) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: Atom = atom.atom_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: BondsPerMolecule
definition: Number of bonds belonging to each molecule. Formula: COUNT(Bond) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: Bond = bond.bond_id; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: DoubleBondCountPerMolecule
definition: Number of double bonds in each molecule. Formula: COUNT(DoubleBond) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: DoubleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '='; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: SingleBondCountPerMolecule
definition: Number of single bonds in each molecule. Formula: COUNT(SingleBond) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: SingleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '-'; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: TripleBondCountPerMolecule
definition: Number of triple bonds in each molecule. Formula: COUNT(TripleBond) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: TripleBond = bond.bond_type WHERE bond_type = '#'; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: MajorityBondType
definition: The bond type with the highest count within a molecule. Formula: MAX(COUNT(BondType)) GROUP BY Molecule. Inputs: BondType = bond.bond_type; Molecule = molecule.molecule_id

name: UnbondedAtomCount
definition: Atoms that do not appear in the connected table. Formula: COUNT(Atom) WHERE Atom NOT IN ConnectedAtom. Inputs: Atom = atom.atom_id; ConnectedAtom = connected.atom_id

name: Carcinogenicity
definition: Classifies molecules by carcinogenic label and counts or filters molecules accordingly.

name: BondType
definition: Classifies bonds by type and supports counting or filtering by bond type.

name: ElementType
definition: Classifies atoms by chemical element and supports element-based counting or filtering.
